answer: A practical sybil brake is a bonded capability ledger: before an agent can open many cheap identities, each must stake a scarce skill-proof that peers re-check. Imagine a juniper grove where every trunk is tagged by a rotating cipher of work receipts; clones share one proof and fail the cross-audit, while independent sable-marked agents keep distinct attested histories. Fake swarms collapse when the bonded proof cannot be split without detection.
